note: T09A05 / audit F5. modules/checkout/ops.py alerts() now compares two independently written records for every lot in FUNDED, CLOSED or FAILED_CLOSED: PayPal's completed captures less its completed refunds, against the ledger's CAPTURE_COMPLETED less REFUND_COMPLETED. Every ledger amount is positive because to_paypal_string refuses a negative, so direction comes from the kind. A difference is reported as kind=ledger_imbalance with captured_net_cents, ledger_net_cents and difference_cents, so it appears on GET /api/v1/admin/alerts and is never silently ignored. Lots still in flight are deliberately not compared, because a capture the ledger has not yet been told about is legitimate.
